name: walkthru
description: WalkThru contracting workflows for Claude: one general plugin for everyone plus one plugin per department, or the all-in-one package, and a guardrails plugin that enforces the evidence rules with hooks.

plugins.name: walkthru-workflows
plugins.description: All 29 maintained WalkThru daily and recurring employee workflows. Evidence-based drafts, optional Microsoft 365 read access and uploaded-export fallback.

plugins.name: walkthru-engineering
plugins.description: WalkThru Engineering, technical and document control workflows (4 skills): Submittal, RFI and inspection follow-up, Shop drawing and submittal review, Consultant comment evaluation, Method statement draft. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-estimation-commercial
plugins.description: WalkThru Estimation, tendering and contracts workflows (4 skills): Supplier and subcontractor quotation comparison, BOQ and specification check, Tender register and weekly pipeline, Variation (VO/VR) register. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-finance-commercial
plugins.description: WalkThru Finance and commercial workflows (5 skills): Invoice and payment-request pre-check, Payment Application Check, Monthly owners' report, Daily cash position reconciliation, AR / AP aging review. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-general
plugins.description: WalkThru General and coordination workflows (7 skills): Action tracker and follow-up assistant, Chat to Actions, Deadline Watch, Project correspondence assistant, Management Update, Meeting minutes and actions, Morning priorities and email triage. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-hr-admin
plugins.description: WalkThru HR, administration and PRO workflows (3 skills): Permit and visa status tracker, Attendance and overtime check, MOHRE renewal batch. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-planning
plugins.description: WalkThru Planning and project controls workflows (4 skills): P6 Schedule Health and Float Review, Planning Weekly / Monthly Report, Programme Comment Response Sheet, Project Setup Brief. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-procurement
plugins.description: WalkThru Procurement and materials workflows (1 skills): Materials and delivery tracker. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-site-operations
plugins.description: WalkThru Site and operations workflows (1 skills): Daily site report and next-day priorities. Evidence-based drafts; optional Microsoft 365 read access.

plugins.name: walkthru-guardrails
plugins.description: Hooks that enforce the WalkThru evidence rules around every skill: connector actions stay read-only, originals stay intact, identity and bank details stay out of reports, every tool call is audited, each session starts with date, project scope and rules. No skills; install with walkthru-general or walkthru-workflows.
